policy: Differences are comparison minus reference, keeping each power case and generator separate.
Completed power-pair audits and every source/output hash are rechecked. Their unchanged session audits are reused; no scheduler is replayed.
Owner IDs, admitted draw indices, rates, home power and within-owner weights match. Energy and derived occupation/idle values may differ.
Poisson proposals match including rejected and warm-up events. Availability common serial marks match; their calendar starts and counts may change.
Availability idle parameters are recalibrated for each energy case. Effects include that policy response.
The parameter bank was screened across all energy/power cases. Results condition on that shared screening, finite bank and common completeness cohort.
MCSE uses whole-cohort paired replicate differences. Fixed fitted-distribution and input/model uncertainty are not included.
All calibration review selections remain included. The open-upper extension is outside this common-cohort comparison.
Near-target pooled frequency does not establish owner/context agreement, stationarity or empirical accuracy. Profile peak is peak of the ensemble mean.
